Name: Writ Block
Description:
You write a line of arcane text describing one target you can see within 60 feet; you describe their current state and enforce that text to prevent them from changing. Choose one of the following options when you cast this spell:
● Attack rolls
● Armor class
● Saving throws
● Ability checks The target must make an Intelligence saving throw (which they may willingly fail). On a failure, any effects that would change or alter your target, e.g., effects that give advantage or disadvantage, grant AC, reduce or improve attack bonuses, etc., do not affect the type of roll you picked, and they make those rolls as if nothing was improving or penalizing them.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell at 3rd level or higher, you may choose one additional target within range for every slot level above 2nd.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
